title: Shipping and Carrier Management Competitive Landscape

scope.description: Multi-carrier shipping, checkout delivery-option and transport management software competing with DeliveryMatch for webshops, omnichannel retailers, wholesalers, 3PLs and brokers in the Benelux and wider Europe.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: vendors that sell multi-carrier shipping, checkout delivery-option or delivery management software to the same segments in DeliveryMatch's home market and that buyers name as alternatives, plus the large international multi-carrier platforms (Metapack, ShipStation, ShippyPro) that compete for cross-border European retailers. Excluded: carriers' own portals, WMS products with built-in shipping (including sibling Picqer), post-purchase tracking/returns-only tools (covered in the returns domain), and sibling Katapull brands, which are partners. Paazl and Transsmart are covered under their owners Wuunder and nShift.
scope.notes: Figures are company-reported with each company's own scope. DeliveryMatch's own figures (200+ carriers, 4,000+ users, 350+ integrations) are in DOMAIN.md and are not directly comparable.

players.name: Sendcloud
players.description: Self-service shipping platform founded in 2012 by webshop owners; the most visible alternative for small and mid-size webshops, with checkout, labels, tracking and returns. Absorbed the Dutch shipping tool Sendy.

players.name: nShift (incl. Transsmart)
players.description: Delivery and experience management platform formed in 2021 from Unifaun, Consignor, Transsmart, Returnado and Webshipper; Transsmart is widely used by ERP-led shippers in the Benelux - DeliveryMatch's closest enterprise competitor.

players.name: Wuunder (incl. Paazl)
players.description: Checkout and shipping platform based in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany that acquired the checkout specialist Paazl in 2024; competes directly on dynamic checkout ('GreenChoice' steering by speed, cost and CO2) and is a Certified B Corporation since June 2026.

businessStats.scope: carrier connections across Europe and worldwide, company-reported

players.name: MyParcel
players.description: Shipping platform for webshops offering order import from webshops and marketplaces, shipping rules, a dynamic checkout included by default, branded track-and-trace and a returns portal. DeliveryMatch also lists MyParcel among its broker integrations.

players.name: Viya (ShipitSmarter)
players.description: B2B multi-carrier shipping software (TMS) for logistics teams, covering shipment creation, carrier selection, booking, tracking, proof of delivery and freight settlement - a competitor in DeliveryMatch's wholesaler and manufacturer segment.

businessStats.scope: shipments processed annually through Viya, company-reported
carrier and system integrations combined, company-reported

players.name: Metapack
players.description: Enterprise delivery management platform (carrier management, checkout delivery options, labels, tracking, returns) used by large European retailers; part of the ShipStation Global (Auctane) group. Competes with DeliveryMatch for enterprise and cross-border retail shippers.

businessStats.scope: packages sent annually through the platform, company-reported

players.name: ShippyPro
players.description: European multi-carrier shipping software for e-commerce merchants (label creation, carrier rate comparison, checkout delivery options, tracking and returns); founded in Italy in 2016 and selling across Italy, Spain, France, Germany and the UK.

businessStats.scope: carriers available worldwide, company-reported (elsewhere on the same page 180+ / 191)

players.name: ShipStation
players.hq: Austin, United States (assumption from company history)
players.description: Self-service multi-carrier shipping software for online sellers, the flagship of ShipStation Global (Auctane, also owner of Metapack and Packlink); the global benchmark for SMB shipping tools, mainly present in the UK among European markets.

businessStats.scope: carriers available for rate shopping, company-reported
